title: API Token Controls
scope: Admin controls, logging and revocation for API credentials on SaaS platforms. Sourced from vendor documentation; not an audit of any tenant.

definitions.conditional: Documented, with plan, policy or endpoint conditions.
definitions.excluded: The named control explicitly does not cover this credential.
definitions.not_supported: Vendor documentation states this credential lacks the control.
definitions.unknown: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_verified: No source found either way. Not a negative finding.
definitions.not_applicable: Does not apply to this credential.
definitions.limited: Documented for a narrower case only.

providers.name: Google Cloud
providers.scope_notes: Covers Google Cloud (IAM, API Keys, Cloud Storage). Covers Google Cloud project/org credentials; org policy constraints and VPC Service Controls need an organization resource; Workspace user OAuth and domain-wide delegation are in the separate `google` platform.

controls.name: iam.managed.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation (legacy iam.disableServiceAccountKeyCreation)
controls.what: Blocks creation of new service account keys and SA HMAC keys.
controls.setting: Organization policies > constraint; gcloud resource-manager org-policies enable-enforce

controls.name: constraints/storage.restrictAuthTypes
controls.what: Rejects user-account and/or service-account HMAC-signed requests to Cloud Storage.

controls.name: Deactivate / delete HMAC key
controls.what: Set the key INACTIVE or delete it; deleted keys are invalid immediately.
controls.setting: Cloud Storage > Settings > Interoperability; hmacKeys update/delete

controls.name: VPC Service Controls
controls.what: Service perimeters with ingress rules limit API access by network origin and identity, even with stolen credentials.

controls_unknown: Whether existing keys created before iam.serviceAccountKeyExpiryHours was set get an expiry (docs say 'newly created').
Whether API keys support an expiry setting.
Which audit field identifies the API key or HMAC access ID used on a data-plane request.
Whether GetKeyString/lookupKey calls are logged for keys.lookupKey.
Plan/pricing for VPC Service Controls (needs organization).

authentication.summary: Access ID + secret used to sign Cloud Storage XML API requests (S3-compatible). Usually tied to a service account; user-account HMAC keys also exist.

federation.details: Signed requests carry no IdP session. No doc ties HMAC use to SSO or CAA.

ip_restriction.boundary: No per-key IP list found. VPC Service Controls can restrict Cloud Storage access by network.

lifetime.summary: No expiry documented on fetched pages; valid until deactivated or deleted

renewal.summary: Rotate by creating a new key, updating clients, then deleting the old key.

administration.summary: disableServiceAccountKeyCreation also blocks SA HMAC key creation; storage.restrictAuthTypes rejects HMAC-signed requests org-wide.
administration.conditions: Org policies need an organization resource.

offboard.details: Deleting the account deletes its HMAC keys, and docs warn user-account keys break when the user is disabled after leaving.

inventory.details: HMAC keys are listed per project (gcloud storage hmac list / ListHmacKeys); HMAC keys are not in the Cloud Asset Inventory asset type list.

usage.ui: Metrics Explorer: storage.googleapis.com/authn/authentication_count grouped by access_id; key admin events in Logs Explorer: protoPayload.serviceName="storage.googleapis.com"

reads.ui: Enable Data Read for Cloud Storage (IAM & Admin > Audit Logs); Logs Explorer: protoPayload.serviceName="storage.googleapis.com" (object get/list)
reads.cli: gcloud projects set-iam-policy PROJECT_ID policy.yaml (auditConfigs DATA_READ for storage.googleapis.com)

offboard.ui: Google Admin console > Directory > Users > (user) > More options > Delete user (deleting the account deletes its HMAC keys)

token_format.notes: Access ID 61 chars for SA, 24 chars for user; example starts GOOG. Secret is 40-char base64.

credential_id_fields.notes: Field carrying the HMAC access ID not found in fetched docs.

lifecycle_events.notes: Operation label in Storage audit log table; exact methodName not listed

anomaly_cues: New HMAC key on a privileged SA

containment.steps: Set the key INACTIVE, then delete it.
containment.notes: Deleted HMAC keys are immediately invalid.

unknown: Exact methodName strings for HMAC events

calls.call: Cloud Storage XML API object GET/list (HMAC-signed)
calls.log_notes: DATA_READ Data Access; off by default

unknown: Whether HMAC access ID appears in the Data Access log entry
